title: Fatal Grudge — Fatal Grudge was not castable from hand even with basic lands of its colors readily available.
scope: Fatal Grudge {B}{R} cast gate with Required Sacrifice additional cost; native engine, P0 + P1 human driver seats, protocol-98 driver
result: A1 setup passed (P0 PreCombatMain holding priority, Fatal Grudge in hand, untapped Memnite + untapped Swamp + untapped Mountain on P0's board, Memnite on P1's board, life 20/20). Across 4 separate P0 main-phase observations the engine's cast gate advertised ONLY PassPriority - no CastSpell for Fatal Grudge in flat legal_actions or in viewer_interaction (0 castspell_advertised events, 0 CastSpell submissions, 0 rejections). The additional-cost sacrifice was never reached because the cast itself was never offered. The reported 'not castable from hand' reproduces on v0.99.0.

assertion_detail.A1_setup_ok: pre: turn 14 PreCombatMain, P0 holds priority, Fatal Grudge in hand (oid 43), Memnite on P0 BF ['42'], 6 untapped Swamp + 1 untapped Mountain, P1 Memnite on BF ['116'], life 20/20, stack 0

assertion_detail.A3_cost_paid: not-run: cast never offered, additional cost never reached
assertion_detail.A4_opponent_sac: not-run: cast never offered, opponent choice never reached
assertion_detail.A5_draw: not-run: cast never offered, resolution never reached
assertion_detail.A6_cleanup: post: wf=Priority/p0, stack=0, rejections=0; game proceeding

limitations: Browser UI not exercised; native engine via two human driver seats.
Dense playsets are a test-harness convenience (engine accepts >4-of for custom games).
The failure is at the cast gate; the additional-cost sacrifice, opponent choice, and draw were never reached (A3/A4/A5 not-run).
States are authoritative exports, restorable only via full game replay (driver/scenario_7343.py), not direct load.
Not tested on the report's original build (Discord report, 2026-08-13); verdict scoped to v0.99.0, not a fix claim.
driver_notes: Protocol-98 driver: MulliganDecision {"choice":{"type":"Keep"}} gated on pending[] Declare; BottomCards via single SelectCards; both seats driven (no AI) for a deterministic opponent board.
P0 lands: Swamp first then Mountain; P1: Mountains + Memnite. No attacks declared (empty DeclareAttackers) so the board is static.
The no-offer observation repeated across 4 P0 main phases (turns 14-17) with identical conditions; the driver then exported post.json and stopped rather than retry indefinitely.
